title: Godot crashes when there's a mesh with a shader that uses hint_normal_roughness_texture and a reflection probe
body:
### Tested versions


- Reproducible in: v4.5.dev3.official [28089c40c]
- Not reproducible in: in v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397] and earlier

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3 - Arch Linux #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 20 Apr 2025 12:38:36 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 570 Series (RADV POLARIS10) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When on a scene there's a mesh using a shader that has a `sampler2D` with `hint_normal_roughness_texture` and a reflection probe, Godot crashes. This backtrace was produced from a custom build based on the same commit as v4.5.dev3 with `dev_build=yes`:

[3] RendererSceneRenderImplementation::RenderForwardClustered::_render_scene(RenderDataRD*, Color const&) (/home/artyif/godot/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:1914)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open MRP
2. Try adding a ReflectionProbe to the scene
3. Editor crashes
